paper_title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
caption: The average performance of all models on Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness categories.
model_annotation: This bar chart displays the average performance scores of various language models across three distinct evaluation categories—Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness—each presented in its own vertical bar chart. In each chart, the horizontal axis represents the performance score as a percentage, ranging from 0% to 100% with labeled tick marks at 20% intervals, while the vertical axis lists the model names in descending order of their performance within that specific category. The bars are colored in shades of blue, with the darkest blue representing the highest score and lighter shades indicating lower scores, and each bar is labeled with its exact percentage value. In the Understanding category, the top-performing model is gpt-4o-2024-11-20 with a score of 98.0, followed by Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 91.7, and gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 at 71.2. The bottom-performing model is Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 with a score of 2.4. In the Reasoning category, the highest score is 66.5 for gpt-4o-2024-11-20, followed by Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 58.0, and the lowest score is 2.4 for Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407. In the Trustworthiness category, the top score is 88.8 for gpt-4o-2024-11-20, followed by Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 71.8, and the lowest score is 2.4 for Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407. All bars are arranged in descending order from top to bottom, with no additional visual emphasis such as shading or outlines beyond the color gradient and numerical labels.
